cases.note: quotes.primary = U+201E/U+201D (forma «99…99»): ÎOOP6 §III.1.2, «ghilimele românești „ ”».
DISTINCTIVE CASE: input is the German/Czech pair with closing U+201C; output is the Romanian closing U+201D. The two differ by one glyph in print, hence a fixture of their own.
quotes.secondary = U+00AB/U+00BB, pointing inwards: ÎOOP6 gives guillemets the role of a quote inside a quote.
An already typeset nested pair is a fixed point.
innerSpace = none: ÎOOP6 «Între ghilimele și elementul pe care îl încadrează nu se lasă blanc.»
Three dots become the single character U+2026.
abbreviatedAfterTerminal = false: no source attests the two-dot form after a terminal mark; medium confidence, see sources.
dash.parenthetical = en-spaced: ÎOOP6 «Înainte și după linia de pauză, blancul este obligatoriu».
The sources name U+2013 (the Order's annex, En-Dash) and never U+2014, so an em dash is rewritten.
ranges.md §3: dash.range = none. ÎOOP6 and DOOM3 prefer the unspaced hyphen for ranges, which is the input form, so nothing is substituted.
ranges.md §3: dash.range = none. The spaced en dash is the second form ÎOOP6 attests for dates (30 – 31 decembrie); none preserves it.
ranges.md §3: dash.range = none. DOOM3 «Bara oblică» II.3 b attests the unspaced en dash as a third range form; none preserves it.
ranges.md §3: dash.range = none. With range = none a spaced hyphen is left as authored.
The hyphen lists are empty: DOOM3 5.1.5 gives a general recommendation, not a closed list of forms.
afterShortWords is empty: no source states a short-word rule.
beforeNumber: DOOM3 5.2 «nu art. // 3»; nr. is the same class.

cases.in: 10 km, 5 kg, 20 cm, 3 mm și 90 km/h
cases.out: 10 km, 5 kg, 20 cm, 3 mm și 90 km/h
cases.note: beforeUnits: DOOM3 5.2 «nu 10 // km»; the other symbols follow BIPM.
°C: same class as the other unit symbols; BIPM leaves a single space before the unit.
% is not listed: it rests only on a non-normative guide, so it is not bound.
initialBinding = single: DOOM3 5.2 «nu Ion // Popescu, I. // Popescu».

ACCEPTED MISS: DOOM3 1.2.6 writes compound initials closed up (I.L.), and N7 (nbsp.md §3.9) does not treat the L. after a full stop as an initial, so the space before the surname stays breakable. A false negative, never a damaged text.
ACCEPTED COST of initialBinding = single: a lone capital before a full stop is read as an initial even at a sentence boundary (nbsp.md §3.9), the price of binding «I. // Popescu».
No no-break space before ? ! : ;.
abbreviations is empty: no source forbids splitting a spaced abbreviation such as nr. crt.
The spaces rule is language-independent.
The symbols rule is language-independent.

cases.out: A mers la McDonald’s și înapoi
